latestVersion.changelog:
Major update: Introduces a controlled, auditable self-evolution protocol.

- Adds a three-tier permission/safety system for different types of self-improvement actions.
- Enforces mandatory audit trails, automated backups, and rollback commands for every change.
- Requires human approval for critical modifications and audit of all self-evolution steps.
- Establishes sandboxing for testing new skills and configurations before deployment.
- Prohibits circumventing safety, audit, or rollback mechanisms in any self-modification.
- Provides clear notification and recovery procedures in case of failures or suspicious changes.
